evidence: STATIC NESTING - VERIFIED. task/task.toml:18 [agent].timeout_sec = 7200.0; :21 build_timeout_sec = 600.0; :27 [verifier].timeout_sec = 13200.0. task/tests/test.sh:207 `timeout "$budget_sec" rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1` (judges run sequentially, so per-suite sums are the right comparison); :213 `run_suite gates 1500`; :224 `run_suite scored 11100`. Judge timeouts ([judge] line 4 of each judge.toml): gates/render 600, gates/constraints 600, scored/functional 9000, scored/polish 900, scored/visual 900. Arithmetic: each gate judge 600 < 1500 and gate sum 600+600 = 1200 < 1500 (300 s slack); each scored judge < 11100 and scored sum 9000+900+900 = 10800 < 11100 (300 s slack); budgets 1500+11100 = 12600 < 13200 (600 s slack); internal-sheet 'sum of judges < verifier': 600+600+9000+900+900 = 12000 < 13200. Liveness: test.sh:115-122 polls up to 120 x (probe + 0.25 s); probe uses urlopen timeout=2 on two URLs (test.sh:48-50), so a hanging-socket worst case is ~120 x 4.25 = ~510 s, typical refused-connection case ~30 s; 12600 + 510 = 13110 < 13200, so even the worst pre-suite liveness wait plus cp -a of /app fits (tight, ~90 s). Restart helper waits 120 x 0.25 s (+probe) and is wrapped by restart_mcp.py HELPER_TIMEOUT_SEC = 55, far inside the 9000 s functional judge. TEMPLATE PARITY: task test.sh, tools/restart_mcp.py, tools/score.py, environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical (sha256) to rules/projects/webdev-task-template; task.toml agent/build/verifier timeouts and all five judge timeouts equal the template values (600/600/9000/900/900, budgets 1500/11100, verifier 13200) and the staged-task-contract.md:111 reference. No timeout was changed, so no authorization record is required. BUILD: agent image is template Dockerfile (apt 4 pkgs + npm -g express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, which ships prebuilt node22 linux binaries); 600 s is plausible for a cold build but not measured here. WORKLOAD - NOT MEASURED. scored/functional has 44 binary criteria in one batched judge session (judge.toml 25.5 KB, prompt.md 19 KB, 55 lines) requiring multiple reloads, a second tab/context, two 'wait up to 15 seconds' live-update checks and restart_app (prompt.md lines 1, 11, 39, 41, 47, 51); polish 5, visual 5, gates 1+1 criteria. raw-evidence-index.json (hashes re-verified) explicitly states 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent' and each entry is 'Not a configured judge run ... or judge-duration measurement'. No full configured judge run, no target-builder (agent 7200 s) run, and no cold build timing exist for this input hash, so 'long enough' for the 9000 s functional session with GLM-5.3-flashx and the 7200 s agent budget is unmeasured. Per REVIEW_POLICY 'Workload is measured, not inferred from a timeout number' and SKILL 'Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass', the row cannot be cleared as Pass; nesting half passes, adequacy half is a missing-measurement risk, hence Note with risk=true (the Note does not waive the measurement). Counterexample probes: (a) a plausible broken app cannot exploit timeouts - a hung/never-ready app exits at test.sh:123-125 with the pre-written zero reward, and a judge timeout yields no credit, never extra credit; (b) a conforming but slower app (e.g., slower page loads or a live-update path that uses the full 15 s window repeatedly) could push the 44-criterion functional session past 9000 s or the scored suite past 11100 s, causing `timeout` to kill rewardkit, run_suite to fail and test.sh:224-225 to exit with the gates-only/zero record - a harness failure attributed to the model. Whether that margin is real is exactly what the missing full-run timing would show.
counterexample: Not a demonstrated defect. Hypothetical risk: a correct but slower submission makes the single batched 44-criterion functional judge exceed its 9000 s timeout (or the scored suite exceed 11100 s); test.sh:224-225 then exits without scored results, so a conforming app receives a zero/gates-only reward. Unmeasured for this input hash.
suggested_fix: Do not change budgets; record a full configured verifier run (golden and at least one slower/weak app) for this input hash with per-suite and per-judge wall-clock from rewardkit logs, plus a cold agent-image build time; only if functional exceeds a safe fraction of 9000 s, reduce browser work/criteria or obtain authorized, justified (<5 h) timeout changes.
